newsitem.title: USA: Group Financial buys Datatape from Delta Tango.
newsitem.headline: Group Financial buys Datatape from Delta Tango.

text.p: Group Financial Partners Inc said Tuesday it agreed to buy Datatape Inc from Delta Tango Inc of Santa Barbara, Calif., for an undisclosed price.
The holding company with diversified interests in electronics and other industries said the companies expect to close the deal by September.
Group Financial said private Delta Tango bought the information storage division Datatape from Eastman Kodak Co in 1994. Company officials were not immediately available to elaborate on the deal.
